text: I’ve had this app installed for a while. I’m trying to add images to an existing layout. I can’t drag them around to rearrange, or add images to existing placeholders. There’s no way to save a session to continue it later. The Export function lets you export a jpeg or a png of the screen with a “Share” button, but the “Save” button apparently does nothing. I tried searching for a solution, and came up empty. Somehow I discovered that the Smartist app saves the jpeg into the User Library/Containers folder with a long code name. No dialog to select the folder; no way to change its name. The bot couldn’t help me with that; and an email to the “help” desk was never responded to. The biggest failure of this app is the lack of any clear documentation. Its quirky user interface and lack of features that have been with Mac for years lead me to recommend other ways of modeling artwork in a physical environment. This app has promise, and some of the customization features are interesting, like the ability to remove or add other objects seem like they’d be useful. I’ll often find myself scrolling on similar apps, such as Instagram, but given how long it takes everything to load on ArtFol I never find myself interested enough to stay on the app. That being said, I really love the gallery not being limited to set size images. Being able to upload images in their original shape and the app auto sizing everything to make your gallery appealing is amazing. I also really appreciate the efforts they make to ensure the picture quality isn’t downgraded. All things considered, this app is mediocre. It struggles to do the one thing it promised to (encourage better engagement for artists) and it has loading times that make using it a nuisance. text: I’ve been beta testing it since it first came out. In its current state, I can’t recommend it to any artist looking for a place to post their art and grow their audience. Do you draw comics? The only categories on the app are the following: Character Art Fan Art Portrait Illustration Landscape Sketch Honestly, it’s been pretty disappointing so far but I still have a lot of hope. It’s still very laggy on iOS for me, but it could be my overall connection. The user interface is great, but currently it feels like the community is made up of a very specific type of artist, and that is generally a younger audience of fan artists and anime fans, so it’s very difficult to gain followers and engagement if your chosen medium or art style isn’t one that appeals to one of these categories. The app was advertised to be a better option for artists due to not relying on an algorithm like Instagram’s, however I haven’t seen any benefit to using it over Instagram or Twitter for posting my artwork as far as growth goes. post daily, interact with others, and rarely get more than one like, and I rarely receive interaction from any of my existing followers, and I have heard the same thing from others as well. Maybe there could be a way to show off artists under a certain number of followers? Idk. Anyway... It’s still in its early stages, so I’m still planning on giving it a chance. I know it will improve in the future. Right now it’s difficult to find like minded people on the app who have similar tastes as yourself.
